_about: BF5 (2026-10-21): how the road got to its final measure (read by tools/halve_2026_10_19.js doc).
lines: **How it got there.** The reference decks were rebuilt on the re-derived cards first (`decks --keep`). Then the road was measured at 120 games (`skirmish-pass-bf7-mid`): **15 / 179 main fights green, 159 too easy**, fights 8.5 rounds on average. Two rounds of the tuner followed, on enemy decks only (`--decks-only --wide`; round 1 at 30 games over all 257 tunable fights, `bf7-curve-fixes`, 189 applied; round 2 at 60 games over the 196 still off target, `bf8-curve-fixes`, 75 applied). After round 1 the measure read 49 / 179, after round 2 **59 / 179** (fresh seeds 57). A fix that didn't bring its fight nearer the target was not applied. BF4's finals are kept as `skirmish-pass-bf-after-bf4.jsonl` / `-fresh-bf4.jsonl`.

**The owner's own node fights were not touched** (Map 0's 0-1 to 0-4, the Hedgerow's 1-1 to 1-5 and the Shallows' 2-1 to 2-5, set on the live server and folded in). On the halved cards Map 0's sit at 57–69% (targets 90 / 75 / 60 / 45), the Hedgerow's and the Shallows' at 85–100% (targets 90 down to 40).

**Where it stands.** Green is spread thin: Maps 11, 20, 22 and 24 are mostly green; Maps 5, 6, 9, 10, 13 and 18 have no green fight. Of the 115 fights too easy, 42 are within 10 points of their band, and 29 are 25 points or more over it. The tuner's moves ran out: the map's own cards at the enemy's scheduled level can't make those decks hard enough. The probable cause is the halving itself: the cards' stats halved while the skills' numbers didn't, and the player's Forge levels weigh more against halved stats, so the reference decks (the strongest cards of the pool: Soldier Ant with Formation, Dung Beetle, Riverwing Envoy, Cinder Imp, Archerfish come up most) beat enemy decks drawn from the same pool at their scheduled levels. This is not measured lever by lever. The next lever is the owner's (decision **B11**: halve the skills' fixed numbers, then re-measure); after that, a future "cheat" field for what is left.
